title: Car Maintenance Basics
content: Regular oil changes are essential for engine health. Change oil every 3,000 to 5,000 miles depending on your vehicle.

title: Tire Care
content: Check tire pressure monthly. Proper inflation improves fuel efficiency and safety. Rotate tires every 5,000 to 8,000 miles.

title: Brake System
content: Brakes should be inspected every 12,000 miles. Signs of wear include squealing or reduced stopping power.
